general.description: This very young planet features indigenous silico-carbonated life, which is quite astonishing. Sophonts of the Six Species, however cannot breathe its atmosphere without a respirator, given its high contents in carbon oxyde and sulphurs. The domed habitats are home to Humans, who choose to retain neutrality when the Core League seceded from the Planetarist Alliance, altough the system itself belongs to the Core League.
general.bar: Mostly human colonists and a few merchantbeings trading outworld commodities with them
